article.body:
Title: No Evidence of ESP Deployment in Production

An arXiv entry titled "ESP: Energy-Score Policy for One-Step Multimodal Action Generation" focuses on a research topic, not a factory or infrastructure project. The available record specifies no facility, production process, installed equipment, or capacity. It also provides no evidence of a pilot or sustained operation.

While the paper discusses potential applications, it does not indicate any production deployment or real-world implementation. The absence of such evidence means that industrial output and supply-chain implications remain unspecified.
